title: Sheehan visits Ingo Swann at his New York apartment

tellings.quote: with you. I went to see him at his apartment in New York and we go all the way upstairs up onto the roof

plain: Sometime in the 1970s, a lawyer named Dan Sheehan went to see Ingo Swann, a man known for claimed psychic abilities, at his apartment in New York. Sheehan tells Michels he was there himself, and that the two of them went "all the way upstairs up onto the roof" together. He tells it as part of his own path into the UFO subject, through the people he met along the way.
